SC05340.scientific_value: The native architecture-choice operation asks whether the extra organisational level does useful work. The reviewer executes four jobs with identical required completions but8 versus16 messages and evaluates them under independent unit cost and absence of an extra-level purpose. This supplies a cost/interaction operand, not the responsibility map itself. The author new routing executes the same protected workload under its own actors/jobs and shows a discriminating limitation: unit costs favor flat8 versus nested16, whereas expensive direct links yield flat80 versus nested16. An independently useful level prevents retirement from this cost criterion alone. Thus the forward is real but its conclusion is cost- and purpose-relative. The old observation that nesting cannot create authority remains valid.
